sql: SELECT p.strategy, count(*) AS entries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> 'open') AS settled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> 'open' AND p.pnl < 0) AS losses, round(coalesce(sum(p.pnl) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> 'open'),0)::numeric,2) AS pnl, round((100.0*sum(p.pnl) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> 'open')/nullif(sum(p.quantity) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> 'open'),0))::numeric,2) AS c_ct, max(p.created_at) AS last_entry FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy IN ('Tempmmsell1','Tempmmsell2','Tempmmsell3','Rainmmsell1','Rainmmsell2','Rainmmsell3') GROUP BY p.strategy ORDER BY p.strategy
